edc-lv-2026:k9.bio: Techno DJ and producer who started KNTXT as a club night at Fuse in Brussels in 2015.

sources.excerpt: That said, the DJ-producer firmly stands at the frontline of the ever-growing techno movement.
In 2015, Charlotte de Witte founded KNTXT as a club night in Fuse, Brussels’ premier techno venue.

edc-lv-2026:k18.bio: Jono, Tony and Paavo: the trio behind Anjunabeats and the weekly Group Therapy radio show.

sources.excerpt: Above & Beyond, or Jono, Tony, and Paavo, as they are better known to their legions of fans worldwide, have been at the forefront of electronic dance music for 25 years.
Founders of the iconic Anjunabeats, Anjunadeep and Anjunachill record labels and hosts of a weekly radio show that reaches millions of dance lovers every Friday (Group Therapy)

edc-lv-2026:k25.bio: DJ and producer whose 2013 single "Animals" launched him to mainstream prominence.

sources.excerpt: “Animals” dropped on 17 June 2013 and went straight to the top of the charts all over the world.

The figures are unbelievable: more than 700 million YouTube hits and four consecutive weeks at number one on the Beatport charts, making Garrix the youngest ever DJ to hold the top spot for that long.
The inspiration behind "Animals" not only launched Martin Garrix to mainstream prominence, but many others like him who decided to embrace the big room house subgenre that captivated the mid 2010s.
After receiving main stage exposure at a number of festivals, the track topped the Beatport charts, making Garritsen the youngest producer to hold the position.

edc-lv-2026:k27.bio: Dutch DJ and producer who hosts the weekly A State of Trance show.

sources.excerpt: For more than twenty years, the Grammy-nominated Dutchman has been living to the rhythm of his own international success. His five-time number one position in the critically acclaimed DJ Mag Top 100 DJs poll has been the result of his loyalty to fans, his creativity in the studio, the perseverance with which he hosts his weekly radio show ‘A State of Trance’, and the energy he brings to the crowds in front of him.

In June 2001, Armin van Buuren aired the first episode of ‘A State of Trance’. Fourteen years later, he still hosts the weekly two-hour show, where he presents the biggest tunes of the moment and provides an interactive way for fans to discover new music.
THE PRODUCER Whenever he’s not on tour or having a daddy day with his daughter Fenna and son Remy, Armin locks himself up in the studio.

edc-lv-2026:c6.bio: Electronic duo of Rick Smith and Karl Hyde.

sources.excerpt: While a fortuitous 1979 meeting in a student house in Cardiff would set Rick Smith andKarl Hyde on a collective career path for the next thirty five years (and counting)
Back then (as now), Underworld were anomalous – an electronic act born out of a second wave of British club culture who wrote immersive, cerebral, connective songs.
Smith and Hyde – back to a core duo after the departure of Emerson in 2000

To mark the 30th anniversary, Firestarter is being re-released on black 12 inch vinyl with updated artwork and printed inner sleeves. Featuring the original single, instrumental, and the Empirion and Andy C remixes.

edc-lv-2026:b7.bio: Detroit techno producer and a founding member of Underground Resistance.

sources.excerpt: Founding member of the legendary group Underground Resistance as a ‘Minister Of Information’ with ‘Mad’ Mike Banks & Jeff Mills, his seminal works on Jeff Mill’s Axis and his very own M-Plant imprint paved the way for a wave of stripped-down dancefloor minimalism that directed much of techno’s path throughout the late Nineties.
Robert Hood makes minimal Detroit techno with an emphasis on soul and experimentation over flash and popularity.

edc-lv-2026:q22.bio: Tokyo-based producer known for melodic house and progressive house.

sources.excerpt: Tokyo-based Shingo Nakamura has developed an iconic melodic house style that has reached every corner of the music scene.
He has released on fellow leading electronic imprints Anjunadeep, Colorize, Monstercat Silk, and the iconic Japanese house label Otographic.
Considered a global leader of the Melodic House and Progressive House genres
